notes.title: Free Filter Mode Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/920f110cedf0ec1183ab202ef21aef35b7ead4e8.jpg

Hello agents. 

Today Leviathan wants to share several important bits of news with you - please move your allocated 10 minutes of scheduled work break to a period of time that allows you to digest the announcements.

Filter Mode Update

This update brings six unique visual filters you can toggle on the fly to change the mood, tone, and overall atmosphere of the game. Want to lean into that grainy retro horror feel? Go with 8MM Film or Old Film. Feeling surreal? Try Dreamcore or Fisheye. Craving something more subdued or haunting? Low Saturation and the new Nori-inspired Black and White filter will absolutely dial things up.

We loved messing around with these ourselves. It’s a great way to re-experience some of KARMA’s most intense moments with a whole new vibe.
Are you ready to step back into the darkness and uncover the secrets that lurk in the shadows of your mind?

[previewyoutube=mvyUs4oa-kU;full][/previewyoutube]

20% Discount

To celebrate the new update, we've also put a special week long 20% discount on KARMA - starting RIGHT NOW and running until Monday 19th 6pm BST.

To mark the update (and because we're celebrating our birthday all month), we're offering 20% off for new players on Steam for a limited time. That brings the game down to just $19.99 / £15.99, and it’s the perfect excuse to finally check it out, or recommend it to a friend ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

Steamdeck Verification

Leviathan is also pleased to announce that KARMA has been awarded SteamDeck verified status! Agents who prefer to perform their investigations on SteamDeck can enjoy the full suite of features on the go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/aea7f3184ed8b8d7d72b3adf17e1fabc6903f223.jpg

The Filter Mode Update is not the only post launch feature being added to the game, we've been collecting your thoughts, suggestions and feedback since launch - so standby for further bug fixes and announcements in the near future.

Thanks for all your support. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new filters. Tag us in your weirdest, wildest screenshots. Let’s see what kind of madness you can create!

Until next time.


Mother Is Watching

notes.title: KARMA: First Post Launch Patch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/a7c9273e5c3bf40b1b64286b76b6421eccb1ccc8.jpg

Hello Agents.

What an amazing week it has been since the launch of KARMA: The Dark World! We have been absolutely blown away by the outpouring of love from the community. Your feedback has been invaluable. That enthusiasm and support fuel our passion to deliver even more exciting KARMA related content for you all.

We've got our first patch live right now - but before we get to the patch notes, a little bit of housekeeping for you all ;

Leviathan is in London! 

If you’re attending the London Games Festival, do come and say hello to the team, we’d love to meet you face-to-face and answer any questions you have about the game! 
We're on the bottom floor of the event opposite the presentation / talk stage - so look for the people with microphones then head into the shadows where the cool indie games are!

Share your Propaganda!
We've been lovingly sharing all your virtual photography with the team, as well as your fan art and streams,. This weekend we'll be showcasing some of our favourites here and on our socials - with game keys and codes for the artbook / soundtracks for the ones we like most! 

Make sure you have all your screenshots and creations on socials by Saturday, and remember to tag us @wiredp so we see them!

SteamDeck Support
Don’t worry, Steamdeck fans: we are hard at work on verification support, which should be landing very soon, we will give an update once optimization is completed and we're ready to patch.

Launch Discount - one week remaining!
And remember—you have one week left to take advantage of the Wired loyalty bonus. If you own any Wired game, simply visit the game page where you will find a bundle featuring KARMA. Add it to your library and receive up to 25% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50268/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Martha_Is_Dead/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51873/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Wired_Loyalty_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50269/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Deliver_Us_The_Moon/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51872/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Wired_Loyalty_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51810/KARMA_The_Dark_World__Wired_Loyalty_Bundle/
Post Launch Patch Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/ed9bb7a97fe6270db42fa9b63b9570846c9cbc6f.jpg

 Corrected some Chinese subtitle typos.
 The ad video now correctly loops in the stamping room.
 Players can no longer accidentally get locked in some rooms.
 Adjusted the peeping perspective in Rachel’s house.
 The game no longer gets stuck when videos fail to play.
 Motion blur no longer erroneously re-enables.
 The camera tutorial can now be completed on non-16:9 monitors.
 Players no longer get stuck due to erroneous frame interactions during the Crimson Amber sequence.
 Fixed multiple localisation errors in texts, tips and control prompts.
 Added a VP9 video playback check on the title screen: The system will prompt users to install the “VP9 Video Extensions” from the Microsoft Store if any decoding issues are detected. Please contact support for assistance if needed.


Thank you to everyone for submitting your bugs and your feedback over the past week - we'll continue to monitor your reviews, forums , bug reports and more as the week progresses. So make sure to submit all of the above if you haven't already!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/72909d991ea48704e348f12301e956a830a537bf.png

Hello agents.

We are now SIX days away from launch and our excitement is only growing! We have SO MUCH to share and celebrate over the next week, and hope you're ready to make March 27th the biggest, best launch ever!

That being said, we've been monitoring your feedback from the demo we launched this week, and have updated a few things to let you enjoy your trial employment at Leviathan before the big day even more.


    Added 10 new languages!
    Updated from Unreal Engine 5.1 to 5.4!
    Updated the settings in the Settings menu, introducing a handful of new toggles.
    Updated the upscaler tech to bring you Frame Generation, no matter which GPU you're using, alongside a host of other neat new features.
    Many, many minor bugfixes.


We are watching. Be Productive.

notes.title: KARMA: The Dark World Gets a Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/6a00c15a3553aaaabe1555b587ad9002ef7decd4.png

Hello again agents. 

Leviathan is thrilled to announce that KARMA: The Dark World is launching on March 27th on PlayStation 5 and PC platforms.

To celebrate, the Bureau has authorised the release of the second in KARMA's mind-bending cinematic trilogy of trailers - featuring the haunting new track 'Into the Mist', written and performed by Geng Li, focusing on the stunning visuals, surreal environments and emotionally-charged story inspired by cinema’s finest auteurs with shocking twists at every turn.

[previewyoutube=mhM9jZnk42M;full][/previewyoutube]

We'd like to take a moment to thank all of you for joining us on the journey so far - your support and excitement has been the fuel that's kept the team at Pollard Studio going as they worked diligently to create a game that will be quite unlike anything you've played before, and a story that will stick with you long after the credits roll.

We promise it will be worth the wait.

As part of the announcement we also shared a little example of KARMA's Pro enhancements for those who are thinking of picking the game up on PlayStation, players who are playing on Steam will still want to watch just to soak in a little more atmosphere ahead of launch. 

[previewyoutube=_qWgN3PjeJY;full][/previewyoutube]

We still have SO much to talk about, including confirming pricing and launch discounts - some behind the scenes of the talented voice actors, musicians and developers as they worked on the game, PC specifications and hardware features to expect at launch, and of course, confirmed 'launch timings' across each region, as well as a surprise or two along the way.

Keep your eyes peeled for all of this and more as we step into the next 6 weeks up to launch, we'll be releasing a demo, competitions and more along with everything mentioned above. And once again please PLEASE be sure to wishlist the game, and share this news and the trailer with anyone else who you think might want to join you as a ROAM agent - it makes a huge difference.  

We'll speak again soon, and remember. The gates to Utopia are open to those who serve

[previewyoutube=gqBLsTzCekw;full][/previewyoutube]

Those of you who have played through the demo will recognise some the footage in here, but we' hope the more keen eyed of you will spot a couple of new additions, and wonder exactly what they could add up to.

We are all but Lost Lambs after all... sometimes a little guidance is all we need.

You'll be hearing again from us very soon...

notes.title: Karma Next Fest Activities Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/6a00c15a3553aaaabe1555b587ad9002ef7decd4.png

Good evening agents.

First of all, thank you all for playing and sharing your feedback so far - from reviews to bug reports and suggestions, we are digesting it all and will use it to make the game even more polished before release. 

We've got a few updates around the demo itself, and some ongoing extra activities we have running at the moment that I want to make sure you're aware of! So without further ado :

Demo Patch 1

On the launch of the demo there were some reports of folks not able to progress past the menu due to language settings on first booth being in a language they could not understand.

We identified the issue and this should now be resolved, apologies for the inconvenience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/8b54ed95c6809db71b6763c41f7f03af6acd987c.jpg

Karma Next Fest Bundle Competition

To celebrate the demo launch, we've gathered some of our physical goodies including a shirt, a hand painted statue of your 'friend' from Shawns office, and a nifty vinyl coaster to give away! You can find entry details in the link below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/771c0077e0b7cc27beba774d18e4f32fe414506b.jpg

These aren't gonna be commercially available, so if you've found yourself feeling like a superfan already - now's the time to stake your claim!

Enter here!

Photo Competition

Not a fan of physical? Or simply have a set of skills of a more 'visual' nature? Well we are offering copies of the game away on launch to those who impress us with screenshots, edits, or fanart from the demo!

We've had some VERY cool entries so far, but there's plenty of time running on this - so dive in there and start paying attention to the finer details!

Entry details here
